description: Sample submissions for the 'Road and trail issue report' form. clientId is the idempotency key (formSubmission is unique on formId+clientId). The 'location' answer uses the form runtime's native geopoint shape ({ lat, lng }) so the stored responses match what a real capture produces and the paired-layer mirror extracts the geometry.

response.description: Shoulder washout on Files Creek Road after the storm; one lane partially undermined.
Red oak down across the Bickle Knob Tower Trail about half a mile below the tower.
Cluster of potholes on Georgetown Road near the school bus turnaround.
Loop trail marker missing at the second junction in Stuart Recreation Area.
